trajectory.thought: The series has a strong trend and unstable model ranking across windows, suggesting robust methods like median or trimmed mean are suitable to mitigate outlier models. I will test the median combination of the full pool as a robust baseline.

The median performed well but ranking instability and high correlation among top models suggest robust aggregation (trimmed mean) could reduce variance by removing outliers without losing signal. Testing trimmed_mean with 20% trim to handle potential extreme deviations in a few windows.

The ranking instability (tau=-0.185) and strong trend suggest that simple unweighted averages are fragile. I will test a weighted combination using inverse error weights to leverage the current best performers while maintaining diversity, which contrasts with the previous robust mean-based strategies.
